name: CENNETIC C600 Trunnion 5-Axis Machining Center
summary: The C600 is a trunnion-type 5-axis machining center built for simultaneous 5-face machining of complex parts. Its A/C rotary table suits aerospace, automotive and mold components that need tight angular accuracy in a single setup.
body:
The C600 is a trunnion-type 5-axis machining center built for simultaneous 5-face machining of complex parts. Its A/C rotary table suits aerospace, automotive and mold components that need tight angular accuracy in a single setup.

About this model

This 5-Axis Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
